wishlist/data.description: Emitted when wishlist data is updated or retrieved. This event is triggered after operations like adding items, removing items, or updating quantities in the wishlist.

wishlist.description: The complete wishlist data structure containing all wishlist items, their details, and metadata. Returns `null` if the wishlist could not be loaded.

wishlist/error.description: Emitted when an error occurs during wishlist operations such as adding items, removing items, or fetching wishlist data.

error.description: Error details including message, code, and context about which wishlist operation failed.

wishlist/initialized.description: Emitted when the wishlist component completes initialization. This indicates the wishlist is ready to display items and accept user interactions.
